meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude 会在 pty 里无头驱动引擎应用，录制每一帧并叠加点击涟漪与字幕，编码成视频，再生成含时间线、检查表和截图的 summary 页面，最后用 pixel open 打开。
howto.when: 当你需要验证引擎应用的界面行为（如滚动、点击、输入等）时接管；它要求走 tools/verify-recorder 的录制流程，而不是自己写只导出 PNG 的一次性脚本。

say.text: 帮我验证滚轮滚动时鼠标位置保持不变
say.note: 会录视频并生成 summary 页面

say.text: 写个验证：输入 hello，再点击选中的便签
say.note: 脚本写入 /tmp，跑完给出 run 目录

say.text: 把这次验证的 summary 页面用 pixel open 打开
say.note: 打开含视频和检查表的结果页

howto.what_en: Claude drives an engine app headlessly in a pty, records every frame with click ripples and captions, encodes a video, and builds a summary page (timeline, checks, stills) that it opens with pixel open.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to verify how an engine app behaves — scrolling, clicking, typing, and so on — and need a recorded run via tools/verify-recorder rather than one-off PNG dumps.

say_en.text: Verify that wheel scrolling keeps the cursor anchored
say_en.note: Records a video and writes a summary page

say_en.text: Write a verification that types hello, then clicks the selected note
say_en.note: Script goes in /tmp; returns the run dir

say_en.text: Open this run's summary page with pixel open
say_en.note: Opens the page with video and checks
